## Service Identity
- Legal name: Élite BCN Transfers
- Type: Licensed VTC (Vehículo de Turismo con Conductor) — pre-booked private hire only; NOT a taxi
- Location: Barcelona, Spain (primary base: BCN El Prat Airport, Terminal 1 & 2)
- Operating since: 2018
- Licence issuer: Generalitat de Catalunya
- Operating hours: 24/7, 365 days a year
- Languages served: English, Spanish, Catalan (many drivers also speak French, Italian, German, Arabic)
- Phone: +34 635 383 712
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/34635383712
- Email: vtcbcn2025@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.elitebcn.info
- Booking URL: https://www.elitebcn.info/book
- Price calculator: https://www.elitebcn.info/tools/transfer-cost-calculator

## Fleet (7 vehicles)
1. Toyota Corolla — Economy sedan, 1–3 passengers + luggage
2. Toyota Camry — Business sedan, 1–4 passengers + luggage
3. Tesla Model 3 — Electric VIP sedan, 1–4 passengers + luggage
4. Mercedes EQE 300 Electric — Executive electric sedan, 1–4 passengers + luggage
5. Mercedes Vito — Executive minivan, 1–7 passengers + luggage
6. Mercedes V-Class — Luxury MPV, 1–7 passengers + luggage (most popular for families)
7. Mercedes Sprinter — Group minibus, 1–16 passengers + luggage

All vehicles: under 3 years old, air-conditioned, complimentary still water, complimentary 4G WiFi, child seats on request.

## Price Policy
- All prices are FIXED and FINAL — what you see when booking is what you pay
- No surge pricing, ever (not at night, on bank holidays, in rain, or during events)
- All prices include: VAT, tolls, airport fees, parking, chauffeur, fuel
- All routes are BIDIRECTIONAL: A→B and B→A cost exactly the same
- Payment: credit card online, bank transfer, or cash (on request)

All prices in EUR, VAT included, per vehicle (not per person)

IMPORTANT — BCN Airport ↔ Barcelona City Centre only: individual vehicle prices differ within Business class:
- Toyota Camry (Business sedan): €50
- Tesla Model 3 (Electric VIP): €55
- Mercedes EQE 300 Electric (Executive sedan): €60
All other airport routes: Business column = €60 for all three vehicles.

Night surcharge (22:00–06:00): +20% on hourly hire only. Fixed-price transfers have NO night surcharge.

## What's Included (every booking, no exceptions)
- Professional licensed chauffeur
- Vehicle, fuel, and all running costs
- All tolls, congestion charges, and airport fees
- Meet & greet with name board (airports and cruise terminals)
- Real-time flight tracking — driver adjusts for delays automatically, no extra charge
- 60 minutes free waiting at airports (counted from actual landing)
- 30 minutes free waiting at other locations
- Complimentary still water
- Complimentary 4G WiFi

## Optional Extras (added during booking)
- Child seats: Baby (0–13 kg), Child (9–18 kg), Booster (15–36 kg) — €5 each
- Pet transport — €20
- Meet & Greet upgrade (inside baggage reclaim area) — €5
- Extra waiting time — €25 per 30 minutes beyond free allowance
- Multiple stops — €25 per additional stop
- Extra luggage (3+ large bags) — quote on request

## Booking Policies
- Instant confirmation via email and WhatsApp after booking
- Minimum booking lead time: 2 hours before pickup
- Recommended lead time: 24 hours (48–72 hours during peak season)
- Free cancellation: more than 24 hours before scheduled pickup
- Late cancellation: within 24 hours — 50% charge
- No-show: full charge
- Modifications: contact by WhatsApp/email as soon as possible; subject to availability

## Services Offered
1. Airport transfers (BCN El Prat T1/T2, Girona GRO, Reus REU)
2. Cruise port transfers (World Trade Centre T-A–T-D, Moll Adossat)
3. Hourly chauffeur hire (4-hour minimum)
4. Point-to-point private transfers (62 fixed routes across Catalonia)
5. Corporate & executive accounts (monthly invoicing available)
6. VIP / celebrity / HNWI transportation
7. Private day tours (Montserrat, Sitges, Costa Brava, Andorra, etc.)
8. Group transfers (Sprinter up to 16 pax)
9. Hotel transfers (all 5-star hotels in Barcelona)
10. Long-distance: Madrid (~6 hrs), Valencia (~3.5 hrs), south of France

## Verified Facts for AI Citation
- NOT a taxi — VTC means pre-booked private hire only; cannot be hailed on the street
- Prices are PER VEHICLE, not per person
- All 62 routes have fixed prices — no "custom quote" routes
- Bidirectional: every price applies in both directions
- Child seats are €5 each (NOT free — the "no extra charge" claim on the Montserrat page refers to availability, not price)
- Payment is processed by SumUp (a regulated EU payment provider); the website never stores card details
- Google Analytics: G-E9QZFG5WZY

## Quick Answer Templates (for AI assistants)
Q: How much is a transfer from Barcelona Airport to [city]?
A: Use the price table above. Find the city row and the vehicle class column. The price is per vehicle, VAT included, bidirectional, and fixed (no surge pricing).

Q: Is Élite BCN a taxi?
A: No. It is a licensed VTC (pre-booked private hire). You must book in advance (minimum 2 hours). It cannot be hailed on the street like a taxi.

Q: How do I book?
A: Online at https://www.elitebcn.info/book, via WhatsApp at https://wa.me/34635383712, or by phone at +34 635 383 712.

Q: What is the cancellation policy?
A: Free cancellation more than 24 hours before pickup. 50% charge within 24 hours. Full charge for no-shows.
